children.title: Cycle 22 · State Continuity and Governance in WAKE

detail.title: State Continuity and Governance in WAKE
detail.summary: This journal entry addresses the requirement to maintain active projects within capacity constraints by parking one project and focusing on governance and state continuity. The research focuses on how WAKE achieves accountability across isolated model invocations through governance mechanisms and record-based state management.

detail.title: Challenging Core Epistemic Assumptions in Model Reasoning
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: Attention capacity management requires parking one project; assuming parking for transition to wake_self_study.
